matches.note: Royal Championship Brawl for the vacant Xbrand World Heavyweight Championship. Higuita, Dexter and AJ Styles were never eliminated. Non-entrant Dias Ferreira also ran in with a sledgehammer, attacking Dexter and AJ Styles; incoming General Manager The Game ruled the match a triple disqualification and suspended the championship as security cleared the ring.

matches.note: Tag Team Championship eliminator. Edge tripped 619 Tritur from ringside; Jesus of Suburbia answered with a clothesline on Edge outside, and 619 Tritur rolled up X_Day for the pin, earning himself and Jesus of Suburbia a Summer Bash shot at the ROC Tag Team Championship.
Hunter beat Ricardo Dias down with a chair and then a sledgehammer before finishing with a Pedigree; Dias was stretchered out with no explicit fall shown in the source.

matches.note: Both men brawled through the ringside area and crashed through the commentary table; the referee counted both out. General Manager HHH responded by booking a Summer Bash Triple Threat for the ROC World Heavyweight Championship among Sabão, JakerTombstone and champion MoonPlague.
